verdict.rationale: Pipedream's workflows run unattended on event-driven triggers: Schedule, HTTP/Webhook, Email, RSS and app events. Its documentation covers automatic retries for errored events and email alerts on unhandled errors, and community users report cron execution and auto-feeding pipelines running in production. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on schedule/cron configuration and execution limits (only a community-reported 30s cron limit), and evidence of AI agents running autonomously in the background beyond a marketing tagline.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Today, we support the following triggers: Triggers for apps like Twitter, GitHub, and more, HTTP / Webhook, Schedule, Email, RSS
